metadata.question: Does the urban area extent in Naivasha, Kenya increase from 1986 to 2000?

data.raw_code: 1. Search strategy: Use Landsat 5 TM for 1986 and Landsat 7 ETM+ for 2000 (both surface reflectance collections), filter to the Naivasha area, and pick one dry-season image per year to minimise cloud. 2. Masking: Do NOT mask clouds if the question is about land-cover/urban extent; instead pick the best (least-cloudy) scene per year so urban pixels are preserved. 3. Urban proxy: Build a simple Normalised Difference Built-up Index (NDBI) = (SWIR1 – NIR)/(SWIR1 + NIR); values > 0 give built-up pixels. Threshold 0, then compute total built-up area (m²) inside a Naivasha city bounds polygon. 4. Check: If either year has 0 images → C1. After thresholding if 0 valid built-up pixels remain → C2. import ee
ee.Initialize(project='earthsense-436113')

# 1. Geometry & Time
naivasha = ee.Geometry.Rectangle(36.35, -0.95, 36.55, -0.75)  # ~Naivasha town
year_a, year_b = 1986, 2000

# 2. Data acquisition & check
def best_landsat(year):
    col = (ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2' if year < 1999 else 'LANDSAT/LE07/C02/T1_L2')
             .filterBounds(naivasha)
             .filterDate(f'{year}-01-01', f'{year}-12-31')
             .sort('CLOUD_COVER'))
    n = col.size().getInfo()
    if n == 0:
        print(f"{year} Images: 0")
        print("<answer>C1</answer>")
        exit()
    return col.first()

img86 = best_landsat(year_a)
img00 = best_landsat(year_b)

# 3. Urban extent via NDBI > 0
def urban_area(img):
    nir = img.select('SR_B4').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
    swir = img.select('SR_B5').multiply(0.0000275).add(-0.2)
    ndbi = swir.subtract(nir).divide(swir.add(nir))
    urban_mask = ndbi.gt(0)
    pix_area = img.select('SR_B1').mask(urban_mask).multiply(0) \
                   .add(ee.Image.pixelArea()).reduceRegion(
                       reducer=ee.Reducer.sum(),
                       geometry=naivasha,
                       scale=30,
                       maxPixels=1e9).get('constant')
    return pix_area

area86 = urban_area(img86).getInfo()
area00 = urban_area(img00).getInfo()

# 4. Validation
if area86 is None or area00 is None:
    print("<answer>C3</answer>")
elif area86 == 0 and area00 == 0:
    print("<answer>C2</answer>")

# 5. Result
print(f"1986 urban area: {area86/1e6:.2f} km²")
print(f"2000 urban area: {area00/1e6:.2f} km²")
print("<answer>A</answer>" if area00 > area86 else "<answer>B</answer>")
